chunks.head: come to oneself
chunks.gloss: 苏醒过来、回过神来、恢复知觉
chunks.note: come to oneself = 苏醒、回过神。此 come to 不是'来到某处',而是'恢复知觉/清醒'。文中作 'came to himself'。
chunks.ex_en: He fainted for a moment, but soon came to himself again.
chunks.ex_cn: 他昏了一会儿,但很快又醒了过来。

chunks.head: take root
chunks.gloss: 生根、扎根;(念头等)扎下根来
chunks.note: take root = (植物)扎根,也比喻(念头、习惯)扎下根。此 take 不是'拿取'。
chunks.ex_en: The young apple tree soon took root in the warm soil.
chunks.ex_cn: 那棵小苹果树很快在温暖的泥土里生了根。
